openFindings.title: Visual-review vocabulary never reaches the frontend surface
openFindings.description: The documented visual-review phrases do not reach sk-code-frontend; replaying 'design review findings' and 'design review of this pricing page' resolves to sk-code-review alone.
openFindings.scopeProof: grep hits the phrase in hub-router.json:90 and sk-code-frontend/ROUTER.md:48; the replay of 'review this screen' returns surfaceBundle [sk-code-review, sk-code-frontend].

openFindings.title: Graph metadata still advertises the retired values vocabulary
openFindings.description: sk-design graph-metadata.json keeps ten retired fundamentals phrases in derived.intent_signals while the phase summary says they were removed and the top-level intent_signals carries none of them.
openFindings.scopeProof: grep -n over the file finds the ten phrases only inside derived.intent_signals.

openFindings.title: Phase 2 changed-file table names a file that never changed
openFindings.description: The table says mcp-figma/manual-testing-playbook/figma-to-code/node-to-token-markup.md was modified to point at the frontend reference, but the file is byte-identical to baseline 10474a9567.
openFindings.scopeProof: git diff --stat for the path prints nothing and grep for fundamentals or web-visual-values in the file prints no line.

openFindings.title: Phase 1 routing criterion mixes a five-prompt baseline with an eight-prompt replay
openFindings.description: AC-005 says five baseline value prompts while its verification cell claims all eight value, review and motion prompts, and the packet never lists the eight.
openFindings.scopeProof: The two counts appear only in the AC row and the phase summary; the replay output is not recorded per prompt.

openFindings.title: Hub canonical surface description still omits the three visual references
openFindings.description: The sk-code surface table, surface list and layout comment describe the frontend surface without the three visual references or tokens.css, and description.json keeps the old wording and a stale lastUpdated.
openFindings.scopeProof: grep for web-visual-values in sk-code/SKILL.md prints no line; the surface README and surface SKILL both name the file.

openFindings.title: Shadow-animation performance rule did not move with the depth guidance
openFindings.description: The retired depth-and-detail rule that avoids transitioning box-shadow by animating a pseudo-element's opacity is absent from both new shadow and motion references.
openFindings.scopeProof: grep for pseudo-element in the two new files hits only the touch-target M9 rule, not shadow animation; the old section has no successor.

openFindings.title: Session-expiry exception can be read as client-side authorization
openFindings.description: M33 permits a client-side redirect when a session expires while the page is open and never says data calls must still be refused server-side, so a reader can treat the UX redirect as the authorization boundary.
openFindings.scopeProof: grep for auth in the three new references returns only M33; no adjacent item covers session expiry.

openFindings.title: Visual-review intent does not load the accessibility reference it cites
openFindings.description: WEB_VISUAL_HIERARCHY loads three files but its review pass cites web-accessibility-patterns.md for seven checks, and the router rule says a row loads what it resolves and nothing more.
openFindings.scopeProof: The three-file map is the only stage-two row for this intent; seven A-anchor links in the review pass point at a file not in it.

openFindings.title: Hub canary never exercises the new visual vocabulary
openFindings.description: The sk-code canary has nine cases and no prompt containing a code-frontend-visual keyword, so the regression harness cannot catch the visual-review route failure or a future tie-break change.
openFindings.scopeProof: Parsed all nine canary cases; none of their prompts contains a code-frontend-visual keyword.
